ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low overall contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% of the visible surface consists of low-intensity dark pixels, with high-intensity white pixels restricted to the distal margins of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs are localized at the outer tips of both the left and right lobes, with more prominent white mottling on the right distal edge. The central and proximal regions are uniform low-intensity black/dark gray.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex angle; depth of the notch is approximately 15% of the total fluke height from the base of the visible peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; characterized by numerous small peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes varying between 2-8 pixels in height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edge transition, tapering to a sharp, slightly upwards-tilted point at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, brown-toned textural clusters located at the extreme tips of both lobes, indicating concentrated barnacle colonization; clusters appear as irregular, dense pixel groups.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal tips; significant irregular erosion of the trailing edge topography compared to a smooth baseline.
